name: Gambling Den
author: Oddisz
description: Sell surplus hulls for tokens at any port of size 6 or more. Play Slots, multi-ball Pachinko, Blackjack, or Relic Jackpot. Slots pay hullmods, weapons, fighter LPCs, tokens, credits, and rare story points at 8-token stakes. Relic Jackpot pays one colony item or AI core for three matching symbols. Pachinko targets hullmods, weapons, or tokens. Hullmod rewards skip blueprints you already know or carry. LunaLib sliders control crate sizes, credit payouts, slot odds, and Pachinko prices and rewards.
